input.jobDescription:
Cybersecurity Engineer at DefenseLogic

DefenseLogic provides cybersecurity solutions to U.S. federal government agencies. This position requires an active TS/SCI security clearance.

Responsibilities:
- Design and implement zero-trust network architecture for classified environments
- Conduct vulnerability assessments and penetration testing
- Develop security controls aligned with NIST SP 800-53 and CMMC frameworks
- Implement SIEM solutions with Splunk
- Support ATO (Authority to Operate) packages and RMF processes
- Respond to cybersecurity incidents within classified networks

Required:
- Active TS/SCI clearance (mandatory — candidates without will not be considered)
- CISSP, CEH, or Security+ certification
- NIST Risk Management Framework (RMF)
- Splunk SIEM administration
- Network security (firewalls, IDS/IPS, VPNs)
- Python or PowerShell scripting

U.S. citizenship required. Polygraph may be required post-hire.

Location: McLean, VA (on-site)
Apply at defenselogic.com/careers
